changeSet.author: workflow
changeSet.sql: UPDATE order_chat_threads oct JOIN orders o ON o.id = oct.order_id SET oct.expires_at = DATE_ADD(o.delivered_at, INTERVAL 24 HOUR) WHERE o.status = 'DELIVERED' AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: workflow
changeSet.sql: UPDATE order_chat_threads oct JOIN orders o ON o.id = oct.order_id SET oct.expires_at = DATE_ADD(o.cancelled_at, INTERVAL 24 HOUR) WHERE o.status = 'CANCELLED' AND o.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND oct.expires_at IS NULL
